DefaultDistance.Name: Default distance
DefaultDistance.Hint: Maximum distance proposed for new merchants, in scene units. Distance is measured between token edges.

ActorTypes.Name: Merchant Actor types
ActorTypes.Hint: Comma-separated allowed Actor types (for example npc,creature). Use * for all types.

RequireControlled.Name: Require a controlled token
RequireControlled.Hint: A player must control one of their tokens to open the shop. Disable to automatically use their nearest owned token.

ShopView.Name: Shop view
ShopView.Hint: Personal preference for displaying the catalogue.

CurrencyMode.Name: Currency handling
CurrencyMode.Hint: Automatic uses the complete D&D5e wallet and a single currency in other systems.

CurrencyPath.Name: Actor currency path
CurrencyPath.Hint: Data path used in single-currency mode, such as system.currency.gp. It must begin with system.

PricePath.Name: Item price path
PricePath.Hint: Path used to read a price when an Item is added, such as system.price.value. The GM can edit it afterward.

CurrencyLabel.Name: Currency label
CurrencyLabel.Hint: Short label shown in single-currency mode, such as gp or credits.

ChatReceipts.Name: Private chat receipts
ChatReceipts.Hint: Whisper a receipt to the buyer and GMs after every purchase.
